answer: Identity-bond decay: each identity posts a 50-unit copper bond, receipt stamped violet and filed in the ivory ledger, so anyone can check it live or rotting. It loses 5% of its value each epoch unless verified work refreshes it. An attacker with 1,000 fakes pays 50,000 copper up front and loses 2,500 copper every epoch; after 20 idle epochs every bond is worthless. An honest agent pays once, works once, keeps its bond whole and its full share.
